meta.task_description: Research the given topic thoroughly using web search, source extraction, and structured synthesis.

scoping.instructions: Break the research question into 3-5 specific sub-queries. List them clearly. Do NOT search yet.

searching.instructions: Execute each sub-query via web search. Collect URLs and snippets. Do NOT synthesize yet — just gather raw results.

extracting.instructions: Fetch the top 5-10 most relevant URLs. Extract key facts, quotes, and data points. Record source URL for each fact.

synthesizing.instructions: Synthesize all extracted data into a structured answer. Use tables where appropriate. Cite sources inline. Flag gaps or conflicting information. Write the final output.

verifying.instructions: Review the synthesis for accuracy. Verify that every claim has a cited source. Check for hallucinated facts. If gaps found, note them explicitly.
